observations: Single reporting year (2019). The Water sheet has no year header; year taken from file name and GRI index (all references are to 2019 reports). Units: ML (cell A3).

Data compiled per ICMM Water Accounting Framework (GRI index J68-J70). Withdrawal/discharge/consumption split into High Quality and Low Quality; source-level components (rivers/streams, external storages, aquifer interception, bore fields, entrainment, municipal, waste water) are recorded under other:*_hq / other:*_lq keys and NOT summed into withdrawal_surface/withdrawal_ground (summing would be a computed value).

Water-stressed operations (row 6, 'Operations in water stressed areas'): withdrawal 36027.8 ML of 181516.9 ML total. This row equals the sum of the '*'-marked sites (Jabal Sayid, Pierina, and the five Nevada Gold Mines sites Carlin, Cortez, Long Canyon, Phoenix, Turquoise Ridge), which are exactly the sites with Baseline catchment stress '4. High' or '5. Very high' (col BK). Site-level withdrawal_water_stressed was not recorded separately.
Recycled/reused water (501129 ML) is ~2.8x total withdrawal; reuse efficiency (AX4) 73.4%.
Total change in storage is negative (U4 = -37478.8 ML), driven by Pueblo Viejo (U31 -20301.7) and Nevada Gold Mines (U54 -18373.1), i.e. stored water decreased in 2019.
Several intensity cells (AY-BB) on closure sites hold #DIV/0! errors (cached value 7); these were skipped.

Withdrawal intensity per ounce (AY4 = 0.0213 ML/oz) does not reconcile with Total Withdrawal / Ounces of Gold Produced (T4/BC4 = 0.0241); the per-tonne intensity (AZ4) does reconcile with T4/BE4. The per-ounce denominator is likely gold-equivalent ounces - treat per-oz intensities with caution.

Production in the Water sheet (gold 7526000 oz, copper 370000000 lb) differs from GRI index 102-7 (J12: attributable 5.465 Moz gold, 432 Mlb copper). Water-sheet figures appear to be 100%-basis for operated sites; copper only covers Lumwana + Jabal Sayid (Zaldivar is not in the water data).

Nevada Gold Mines (JV formed 1 July 2019, 61.5% Barrick) is reported as a subtotal row (54) with sites Carlin, Cortez, Long Canyon, Phoenix, Turquoise Ridge; only the individual sites were recorded. Carlin reports storage change -12,459.8 ML and 27,648 ML consumption against 15,188 ML withdrawal. Cortez shows only aquifer-interception withdrawal and no discharge.

Country/region subtotal rows (Mali, Africa and Middle East, Latin America and Asia Pacific, North America, etc.) and row 5 'Operations' (excluding closure sites) were not recorded; '_corporate' uses row 4 'Barrick'. Site withdrawal_total values sum exactly to T4.
Porgera (PNG) has zero consumption-by-evaporation but 26,836 ML Low Quality surface discharge (AE36) - nearly all of its 29,431 ML withdrawal - and 2,595 ML 'other' consumption.

Water non-compliances (sheet 'Incidents and Spills' col G): 19 in total (G3) - Kibali 8, Porgera 7, Cortez 2, Lagunas Norte 1, Hemlo 1. Total environment-related fines count L3 = 0, but 'Value of environmental-related fines' M3 = 18 (no currency; value attributed to Kibali/DRC M10) - not water-specific, so not recorded as water_fines_usd.
No targets or multi-year trend data in this workbook.
